transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in today. What brings you to the clinic?

Well, I'm here because my body just... feels like it's completely out of my control lately. A little while ago, I was constantly moving. I'd be up all night pacing around my apartment, writing down all these ideas for a supper club. I just couldn't stop moving. But now, it's the exact opposite. I feel so slowed down. My sister even pointed out that it takes me forever just to do simple things, like putting on my shoes. It's just really hard to function right now.
How long did that period of constantly moving and staying up all night last?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. It's hard to keep track of time when I get like that. Maybe a couple of weeks? I just know it went on for a while before I crashed.
During that period of constant activity, did you feel unusually euphoric or unusually irritable?

I guess it was a mix of both. It started right after I got fired from my restaurant job. I felt... I don't know, weirdly unstoppable. Just really excited about everything. But at the same time, if anyone questioned my plans or told me I needed to slow down, I would just blow up at them. I really felt like they were trying to ruin my life.
Did these changes in your mood and energy happen only while you were using a substance or going through withdrawal from one?
No, I wasn't drinking or doing any drugs. I mean, I'll have a beer sometimes, but I wasn't using anything when all that started. It just happened on its own.
Did you need to be hospitalized because of that period of unusually high energy and activity?
No, I wasn't hospitalized. I mean, I just kind of stayed out doing my own thing until I eventually crashed at home. So, no, no hospital or anything like that.
Have you been feeling persistently sad, empty, or hopeless most of the day nearly every day lately?

No, I haven't really felt like that. I mean, I'm just kind of dealing with the aftermath of losing my job and all that crazy energy, but I wouldn't say I've been feeling sad or empty or anything like that. Just... normal, I guess. Or trying to get back to normal.
During that period of unusually high energy, did your behavior cause serious problems in your work, relationships, or daily life?

Yeah, it really did. I mean, like I mentioned about losing my job... I just haven't been able to hold together any work plans, or figure out my rent arrangements, or keep up with family commitments. It all just kind of fell apart. It actually got to the point where my sister had to take me to the crisis clinic, just because I couldn't get my basic responsibilities organized on my own anymore.
During that period of unusually high energy, did you lose touch with reality in any way, such as believing things that others said were not true?

No, I didn't have anything like that happen. I mean... I was definitely acting wild and making a mess of things, but I always knew what was real. I wasn't believing anything weird or made up, if that's what you mean. I was just moving way too fast.
